findings.text: blocking: the --check mode enumerates candidates from the index (worktree_path_candidates(root, cached=True) runs `git grep --cached`) but decides from working-tree content (_worktree_path_text reads root/path), so a file staged with a worktree path whose working-tree copy no longer carries it passes the hook while the index blob still names the root; reproduced in a scratch repo where `git grep --cached` returns staged.txt but worktree_path_offenders(candidates, worktree_reader) returns [], and the retired _staged_text read the index via `git show :path`, so this is a regression in the commit guard.

follow-on: _worktree_path_text is named module-private by its leading underscore yet imported across module boundaries (nova/database/scripts.py:9, tests/test_artifacts_carry_no_worktree_paths.py:17); if it is shared API it should not carry the private marker, and if it is private it should not be imported elsewhere.
